title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-oct-2025
content:
Context:
- Weekly cross-functional roadmap alignment: Product + Eng + Applied ML. Goal = surface risks, get alignment on priorities for Q4 roadmap items, unblock model onboarding and dedicated capacity ops.
- Attendees I want present: Priya (PM), Ethan (Infra/Serving), Diego (Applied ML), Sarah (SRE), a reps from Console/Optimize if possible.

Meeting logistics:
- Proposed time: 2025-10-09 10:00–11:00 PT (60m)
- Format: 10m context + 35m topic deep dives (3 topics, ~10m each) + 15m decisions and actions
- Pre-reads: Confluence roadmap summary (linked), INF-3421 ticket (Jira), PR #482 for kernel changes. Ask folks to skim before meeting.

Agenda (rough):
1) Quick context & success metrics (10m)
   - Product ask: tighten rollout window for model variants and quantization experiments (Priya)
   - Eng ask: clarify autoscaling cadence and capacity constraints for Dedicated (Ethan)
   - Applied ML ask: coverage for evals and regression monitoring (Diego)
2) Topic A: Model onboarding cadence + eval coverage (10m)
   - Current: onboarding backlog: 6 models in queue (2 high priority), eval harness incomplete for long-tail prompts
   - Decision requested: commit to onboarding 1 model every 2 weeks for next 6 weeks OR re-prioritize based on customer impact
   - Risk: eval gaps -> regressions slip into prod; limited compute for longer eval sweeps
3) Topic B: KV cache / batching improvements + perf targets (10m)
   - Perf baseline: p50=85ms, p95=420ms for chat workloads (seq len typical 512), cost/1k tokens ~ $0.045 on hosted instances
   - Proposal: enable prefix caching in staged rollout + adjust batch window to 20ms on low-latency routes
   - Decision requested: approve staged rollout and canary on 2 top customers next week
4) Topic C: Dedicated capacity scaling & SLA implications (10m)
   - Capacity ask: need to reserve additional 4 nodes for peak traffic in EU region (capacity commit)
   - Finance impact: estimated +$22k/mo; product needs to prioritize top 3 enterprise customers for this slot
5) Decisions, owners, action items (15m)

Notes / talking points to surface:
- For Product: be explicit about which customers get priority for Dedicated slots; tie to committed revenue (ask Priya for list).
- For Eng: clarify how kernel selection PR (#482) affects rollout timeline; is there a fallback if perf regresses? (ask Ethan)
- For Applied ML: need a lightweight regression smoke test that runs on every model flip; can we auto-run against a small prompt set in CI? (ask Diego)
- SRE: what's the expected alert noise from enabling prefix caching and reduced batch window? Need thresholds. (ask Sarah)

Rough status updates to mention quickly:
- Model onboarding: 6 backlog items; model A (priority) blocked on tokenizer mismatch; model B blocked on quantization profile
- Eval harness: added 1200 prompts, but coverage for multi-turn roleplay is weak (~12% of prompts)
- Autoscale: current policy triggers at 70% node utilization; observed spikes still can cause 1–2s tail latency

Decision/ask list (what I want from the group):
- Priya: share prioritized customer list for Dedicated slots by EOD 2025-10-07 (owner Priya Kumar)
- Ethan: confirm whether PR #482 can go to canary on 2025-10-13 and fallback plan if p95 increases (owner Ethan Brooks)
- Diego: prototype a 50-prompt smoke test for regression detection and add to model-onboard CI by 2025-10-20 (owner Diego Rivera)
- Sarah: draft alerting thresholds for cache/batching rollout and estimated alert volume by 2025-10-14 (owner Sarah Nguyen)
- Me (Maya): consolidate action tracker + update Confluence page after meeting; send follow-up notes within 48h

Action items (scratchpad - I will convert to tracker):
- [Priya] prioritized customer list for EU Dedicated slots — due 2025-10-07
- [Ethan] canary rollout plan + perf rollback criteria for kernel PR #482 — due 2025-10-12
- [Diego] 50-prompt regression smoke test + CI integration for onboarding — due 2025-10-20
- [Sarah] alerting thresholds and estimated noise for cache changes — due 2025-10-14
- [Maya] update Confluence page with decisions, create follow-up Jira tasks (INF-3421 linked) — due 2025-10-11

Open questions to raise in the meeting (notes to self):
- If we commit to 4 EU nodes, which customers are first in line? Can legal/security onboard within 4 weeks?
- Do we have cost-allocation mapping to tie Dedicated cost to customer billing? (finance ask)
- Is the eval coverage for hallucination detection sufficient for model A? Quick metric to show: top-10 hallucination prompts failing = 2 -> need to fix before rollout?

Potential blocking items / dependencies:
- Tokenizer mismatch fix (eng) for model A: depends on PR in serving-runtime repo (PR #482 references the kernel but tokenizer fix is separate)
- Quantization profiling: applied-ml needs ~48 GPU-hours to complete quality sweep for model B
- Legal review for customer data on Dedicated private lanes: may add 2 weeks

Pre-read checklist for attendees (ask in invite):
- Confluence roadmap summary: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=987654
- Jira: INF-3421 (capacity + roadmap)
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/482
- Linear: model onboarding ticket ML-128

Follow-ups I will send after the sync (plan):
- 1) Short meeting notes + decisions (within 24–48h)
- 2) Action tracker with owners/dates in Jira (create INF-3421 sub-tasks)
- 3) If Priya provides prioritized customer list, schedule a 30m follow-up to lock Dedicated slot commitments

Tone/notes to self while running the meeting:
- Keep decisions timeboxed; if a decision needs more data, assign an owner and timeline (no >2-week async unless blocked)
- Push back on scope creep — we only have bandwidth for 2 major rollouts this quarter
- Be explicit about rollback criteria for any perf change (p95 delta threshold, error rate threshold)

Quick scratch TODOs (post-meeting actions I will handle immediately):
- Create Confluence update + high-level notes (10–15m)
- Open Jira sub-tasks for each action and tag owners (15–20m)
- Ping Finance for cost allocation mapping (Priya to intro)

Misc small items / ideas to capture: 
- Consider a small-canary billing experiment to test cost allocation (bill back to a sandbox account)
- Evaluate a weekly short-report for top-5 model regressions to maintain visibility

-- end of prep notes --

(Informal: still rough — will tidy post-meeting. Add any quick notes in Slack #product-roadmap if you read before the sync.)
